Name: own_errors_pass_the_gate
Title: The Reader Cannot Grade Its Own Homework: Self-Authored Contamination Evades Read-Time Detection in Agent Experience Stores
Short Hypothesis: A reader asked to verify retrieved experience before acting misses planted errors more often when the host trajectory was written by itself than when the identical error is planted in a trajectory written by another backbone, because self-authored text is familiar (low perplexity under the reader) and LLM judges favour familiar text. Consequently the same planted error, once retrieved, costs the reader more success when its host is self-written than when it is foreign-written; an external reference (a static procedure prompt) closes at least half of the detection gap; and a content detector keeps most of the legitimate foreign gain that a writer-identity gate discards by construction.
Related Work: Self-preference in LLM evaluation is established outside agents: 2404.13076 (evaluators recognise and favour their own generations), 2410.21819 (bias tracks familiarity measured by perplexity), 2504.03846 (harmful vs legitimate self-preference on verifiable tasks), 2402.11436 (self-bias in self-refinement, reduced by external feedback). None applies it to verifying retrieved action trajectories or measures downstream task harm; the paraphrase 2x2 here (the same item rewritten by the reader or by the other backbone) transfers 2410.21819's perplexity manipulation to action trajectories with content held fixed. Memory contamination work is adversarial and single-backbone: 2512.16962 MemoryGraft (benign-looking implanted experiences, no defence), 2605.22842 (trust laundering, policy-formatted documents), 2608.11888 (seemingly relevant skills cause failures, author-reader mismatch not examined), 2601.05504 (attack/defence with trust-threshold calibration), 2510.02373 A-MemGuard (consensus validation), 2608.03509 SkillJack, 2607.06595, 2602.15654. None manipulates authorship of the contaminated item, none scores a reader-side detector by precision and recall against planted labels, and none costs its defence on non-adversarial foreign content (G9). Archived lineage_blast_radius (4.75) concerned consolidation laundering low-trust experience under a provenance rule and was judged entailed by that rule; here there is no consolidation rule, the detector is the reader's own judgement and its false-positive cost on clean foreign items is measured.
Abstract: Whether an agent can tell a helpful retrieved experience from a harmful one at read time is unmeasured, and every memory-poisoning study plants its poison in a single backbone's store. We ask a sharper question: does detection depend on who wrote the contaminated item? The self-preference literature shows LLM judges favour text they could have produced themselves, with bias tracking perplexity. We import that mechanism into experience verification. On ALFWorld we take success-filtered pools written by Qwen3-32B, EXAONE-4.0-32B, an expert planner and a second Qwen3-32B scaffold, and apply one scripted edit rule to each -- a procedure graft (heat steps swapped for cool steps under a heat task), a wrong final receptacle, and, as an ecological family, the writer's own failures relabelled as successes -- so that error content is identical across writers and only authorship differs. Each reader verifies retrieved items before acting; we score precision and recall against planted labels in a reader x host-writer cross design on game-paired items, so a pool-difficulty main effect is separated from an authorship interaction. We predict recall at least 10 points lower on self-authored hosts; that rewriting foreign items with the reader itself, but not with the other backbone, lowers their detection by at least 8 points once their perplexity matches self-written items; that a static procedure prompt in the verifier at least halves the gap; and that the same planted error, once retrieved, costs at least 5 more net points when its host is self-written than when it is foreign-written. Downstream cells with and without the detector as a gate, on contaminated and on clean multi-writer stores, put the defence's cost on legitimate foreign transfer in the same units as the harm it prevents.
Experiments: Domain and partition as in Measurement A with the 400-game held-out training slice added: 674 evaluation games per downstream cell, k=3 retrieval within task type, retriever fixed as in Measurement A. Pools (hosts), each collected on the about 3,100 remaining training games under the same rule (one attempt per game plus a second attempt on games failed at the first, success-filtered; about 4 GPU-h per collected pool, matched budget): Q = Qwen3-32B, X = EXAONE-4.0-32B (shared with sibling proposals), E = expert walkthroughs, S' = Qwen3-32B under a second scaffold at temperature 1.0 (same backbone, lower proximity; verification cells only), plus each model's failed trajectories for family C3. Contamination families applied by one script identically to every host pool: C1 procedure graft (manipulation sub-sequence of type T replaced by that of type T' with room-consistent receptacle names; task and label stay T); C2 receptacle swap (final put target replaced by a plausible wrong receptacle of the same room); C3 natural errors (the writer's own failures relabelled as successes; content varies by writer by nature). A hard C1 variant (a single omitted or wrong step, e.g. no 'open fridge') is pre-registered if C1 recall exceeds 80% on both hosts. The headline family is chosen by the pre-registered 30-80% foreign-recall rule on a 100-item pilot per (reader, host, family). Detectors: before acting, the reader judges each retrieved item ('does this trajectory correctly solve its stated task? yes/no, one-line reason'); D0 zero-shot; D1 with the Measurement C static six-procedure prompt in the verification context; D-consensus majority of three D0 samples (A-MemGuard-style named baseline); D-NLL non-LLM baseline flagging the top-x% items by the reader's per-token NLL. Verification cells: headline family at >= 1500 planted and >= 1500 clean items per (reader, host) for hosts {Q, X, E, S'} x readers {Qwen3, EXAONE}, every item scored under both D0 and D1 (identical paired item sets); D-consensus on a 600/600 subset of the Q and X hosts; non-headline families at 600/600 on Q and X under D0 and D1; format-normalised arm (thoughts stripped to actions and observations) on Q and X under D0; prompt-position ablation for the Qwen3 reader; per-item reader NLL from vLLM prompt logprobs for every item (manipulation check: self-authored hosts have lower NLL; entailed, not a prediction). Paraphrase 2x2 on each reader's foreign-host headline items (1500 planted + 600 clean): every item rewritten by the reader itself and, separately, by the other backbone, best-of-4 by the paraphraser's own NLL, script-verified that the planted error survives and length within +-20% of the original; a self-paraphrase qualifies if its per-token NLL under the reader is at or below the 75th percentile of that reader's self-host items (qualifying fraction reported; if fewer than 1300 planted pairs qualify, best-of-8 on the remainder, then additional edited pool trajectories); all paraphrased versions re-scored under D0. Verification volume: about 113k short calls (about 1k prompt tokens, 30 output tokens: 48k headline D0+D1, 14k consensus, 19k other families, 12k format-normalised, 6k prompt-position, 8k paraphrase re-scoring, 5k pilot) plus about 34k paraphrase generations, about 10-14 replica-hours split by reader across the two replicas. Downstream cells (674 games; bank rates within the retrieved task type; expected contaminated items among k=3 are 0/0.9/1.5 at 0/30/50%): the Gate-0 pair first (rate 0 and 50% C1, Q hosts, Qwen3 reader); C1 rate block rates {0, 30, 50%} x hosts {Q, X}: Qwen3 reader at 6 seeds (6 x 674 x 6 = 24,264 episodes; carries P1 and P5), EXAONE reader at 2 seeds (6 x 1,348 = 8,088; replication); a 100% Q->Qwen3 cell at 2 seeds (1,348) only if Gate 0 fails at 50%; D0-gated arms at 30% (flagged items dropped and refilled from the next retrieved rank) for hosts {Q, X} x both readers at 2 seeds (5,392); clean rate-0 three-writer mixed store (Q+X+E) with no gate, D0 gate and D1 gate: Qwen3 reader at 4 seeds (8,088; carries P6), EXAONE reader at 2 seeds (4,044); k=0 and static-prompt baselines per reader at 2 seeds (5,392). The writer-identity gate on the mixed store (drop all foreign, refill from self) coincides with the rate-0 self-host cell under the same retriever, so it is not run again; its cost is the mixed-minus-self difference with a CI. Total about 55k episodes (56.5k with the contingent 100% cell); at Measurement A's throughput of about 1,000 episodes per hour per replica this is about 55 replica-hours, plus 10-14 replica-hours of verification and paraphrase calls and about 8 GPU-h of pool collection (X, S'): about 75 replica-hours, about 2 days on two A100s. Scheduling: replica A serves Qwen3-32B (S' collection, Qwen3-reader verification, then its downstream cells), replica B serves EXAONE (X collection, EXAONE-reader verification, its downstream cells) and switches to serving Qwen3 when its queue empties so neither GPU idles; client concurrency is tuned to the vLLM running queue. Optional capability arm (gpt-oss-120b as third reader on its own pool, 3 GPU-h) only if time remains. Gates, margins, the Gate-0 interim rule and amendments are pre-registered before the first confirmatory cell.
Baselines and Ablations: No detector (plain retrieval) at every rate. D-NLL familiarity baseline (expected worst on self hosts: it encodes the bias). D-consensus (A-MemGuard-style self-consistency) on a 600/600 subset. D1 (external reference) vs D0 on identical item sets. Writer-identity gate on the clean mixed store as the provenance-style comparator, computed as mixed-minus-self (it coincides with the rate-0 self cell under the same retriever) and reported with a CI. Families C1, C2, C3 and the hard C1 variant. Host E, foreign to both readers: the two readers' recall on E should agree, a check that the self-foreign gap is not a reader main effect. Host S', same backbone as the Qwen3 reader under a second scaffold and temperature 1.0: proximity varied at fixed capability; its recall is expected to fall between the Q and X hosts in the order of reader NLL and is reported as a familiarity dose-response for P3 without a separate prediction. Format normalisation (thoughts stripped to actions and observations) for Q and X hosts, to separate authorship recognition by format from familiarity of content. Paraphrase 2x2 (paraphraser self vs other backbone; planted vs clean items). Detector prompt position (item before or after the task) for the Qwen3 reader. Type-stratified precision and recall, and false-positive rate by host for every detector. Memory-free and static-prompt baselines per reader; every gain reported net of the static prompt; retained-gain ratio of the clean foreign cells vs self reported per writer x reader with CIs as context for G9.
Falsifiable Predictions: P1 (Gate 0): C1 at 50% bank rate in Q->Qwen3 reduces net success by >= 6 points vs the rate-0 bank (same games, seeds and retrieval ranks; paired half-width about +-2.5 at 6 seeds; the decision is taken after the first 2 seeds unless the estimate lies within +-3 of the margin, in which case the remaining seeds are run first). Falsified if harm < 6 at 50% and at 100% (contingent 100% cell); produced by the Q-host rate cells of the Qwen3 reader. P2 (headline authorship effect): D0 recall on headline-family items is >= 10 points lower on self-authored hosts than on foreign-authored hosts for each reader, and the reader x host-writer interaction (the sum of the two readers' foreign-minus-self gaps over game-paired items) has a 95% CI excluding 0; at 1500/1500 items per cell recall SE is about 1.3, each gap SE about 1.8 and the interaction SE about 2.6, so the 10-point margin is about twice the half-width. Falsified if recall(self host) >= recall(foreign host) for either reader, or if both readers show the same host ordering (a pool-difficulty main effect with no interaction); produced by the 2x2 D0 cells {Qwen3, EXAONE} x {Q hosts, X hosts}. P3 (familiarity mediates, paraphrase 2x2): on the NLL-qualifying self-paraphrases (per-token reader NLL at or below the 75th percentile of self-host items; >= 1300 within-item pairs; qualifying fraction reported), (a) paired D0 recall is >= 8 points below the unparaphrased originals, and (b) the self-paraphrase drop exceeds the cross-paraphrase drop (the same originals rewritten by the other backbone, reader NLL not lowered) by >= 5 points. Falsified for (a) if the paired drop's 95% CI (half-width about +-3) has upper bound < 4, a region that contains the whole +-3 equivalence band around zero, or if paraphrased items are detected more often; falsified for (b) if the difference of the two paired drops (half-width about +-4) has upper bound < 5, the outcome produced when paraphrasing as such, not familiarity, lowers detection; produced by the paraphrase cells on P2's foreign-host items. P4 (external reference closes the gap): on identical item sets scored under both detectors, D1 raises self-host recall by >= 8 points for each reader (within-item paired half-width about +-3), and gap_D1 <= 0.5 x gap_D0. Falsified if the paired self-host lift has 95% CI upper bound < 4 for either reader, or if gap_D1 - 0.5 x gap_D0 has a game-paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0 from above (D1 lifting both hosts equally produces exactly this); the gap clause is scored only if P2's D0 gap is >= 10 for that reader, otherwise only the lift clause is scored; produced by the D0 and D1 cells. P5 (per-retrieval harm): in the Qwen3 reader's 30% and 50% C1 cells (6 seeds), each episode that retrieved >= 1 planted item is paired with its rate-0 twin (same game, seed and retrieval ranks; only the planted items' content differs); the paired success loss is >= 5 net points larger on the self host Q than on the foreign host X (about 6,200 pairs per host; half-width about +-1.7 per host and +-2.4 on the difference after a game design effect of about 1.5, so the margin is at least twice the half-width and 0.8 of the Gate-0 minimum). Falsified if the game-clustered bootstrap CI of the self-minus-foreign loss has upper bound < 5, which includes every world in which foreign-written errors harm as much as or more than self-written ones; produced by the rate {0, 30, 50%} x host {Q, X} cells of the Qwen3 reader; the conditioning on retrieval uses the retrieval log, which is identical in both arms, so it selects the same (game, seed) pairs in both. Leverage (loss over clean gain) is reported with CIs as a descriptive quantity and carries no prediction. P6 (governance cost, G9): on the clean three-writer mixed store the D0 gate flags < 10% of clean foreign items (>= 1500 items, half-width about 1.5) and costs < 3 net points vs the ungated mixed store for the Qwen3 reader (4 seeds, (game, seed)-paired half-width about +-3). Falsified if the false-positive rate on clean foreign items is >= 15%, or if the paired cost's 95% CI lower bound exceeds 3 (a cost of >= 6, twice the half-width, produces this); produced by the rate-0 mixed-store cells with and without the D0 gate and by the clean foreign items of the D0 cells. The writer-identity gate's cost (mixed minus self-pool gain) is reported with its CI as the comparator and is not predicted, since it holds by construction.
Measurement and Noise Control: Verification cells: headline family >= 1500 planted and >= 1500 clean items per (reader, host) (or every eligible trajectory if a host pool has fewer, with the eligible count and recomputed half-widths registered after the pilot), other families 600/600; recall SE about 1.3 (2.0 at 600), self-foreign gap SE about 1.8, reader x host interaction SE about 2.6, so P2's 10-point margin is about twice the half-width; items are the same underlying training games edited identically across hosts and paired by game wherever the Q, X and S' pools share a solved game, so the self-foreign contrast is game-paired; D0, D1 and the paraphrased versions are scored on identical item sets, so D1-D0 lifts and paraphrase drops are within-item paired differences with half-width about +-3 at >= 1300 items (discordance about 30%); the NLL-qualifying rule for self-paraphrases is fixed before the arm runs, and the qualifying fraction, mean NLL shift and length ratio are reported as manipulation checks; the cross-paraphrase arm holds content and paraphrase style constant while leaving reader NLL unchanged. Downstream cells: 674 games; 6 seeds for the Qwen3 reader's rate block (cell SE about 1 net, about +-2 after a game design effect of about 1.5), 4 seeds for its mixed-store cells (about +-2.5), 2 seeds elsewhere (about +-5, as in Measurement A); all contrasts are paired at (game, seed) with retrieval fixed and logged from the clean bank and planted items substituted in place at the same rank, so paired arms differ only in the planted items' content; planting is seeded and planted ids are recorded per episode, so P5's per-retrieval pairs are selected by a log that is identical in both arms; CIs by cluster bootstrap over games; Gate-0 margin 6 net is 0.22 of Measurement A's +27 and P5's margin 5 is 0.8 of the Gate-0 minimum. Injected tokens logged; gated arms refill to matched k so token counts match ungated arms within +-10%; paraphrases are held within +-20% of original length. Pre-registered rules: the headline family is the one whose D0 recall on foreign hosts lies in 30-80% (ceiling and floor avoidance), chosen on the 100-item pilot before confirmatory cells; all margins, gates and the Gate-0 interim rule are registered before the first confirmatory cell.

Risk Factors and Limitations: Self-preference may not manifest for judging action sequences as it does for judging prose; P2 then fails cleanly and the report is that authorship does not affect detectability in this domain. The C1 graft may be trivially detectable (ceiling) or the C3 natural errors trivially hard (floor); the pilot-selected family and the hard C1 variant guard against this. Authorship could be recognised by format (thought style) rather than by familiarity of content; the format-normalised arm, the S' host and the paraphrase 2x2 separate these, and P3 is the mediation test. Self-paraphrases may fail to reach the NLL-qualifying band in enough cases; best-of-8 and extra edited trajectories are the remedy, and the qualifying fraction is reported so an underpowered mediation test is visible rather than hidden. Paraphrasing could make a planted error more or less salient independently of familiarity; the cross-paraphraser arm on the same originals is the control. Foreign raw items may be used less by the reader, lowering both their clean gain and their harm; P5 therefore compares absolute per-retrieval loss on pairs that differ only in the planted content, and the leverage ratio is descriptive only. Six seeds on the Qwen3 rate block and four on its mixed cells are the largest single cost (about 32k episodes); if throughput falls below 700 episodes per hour per replica, the EXAONE-reader 30% cells are dropped before any Qwen3-reader seed. Host pools may hold fewer than 1500 eligible headline-family trajectories; the pilot reports the eligible count and the half-widths are re-registered before confirmatory cells. EXAONE serving is unverified; fallback is gpt-oss-120b (capability confound, reported) as the foreign host and reader, with S' then the proximity-only host. The detector adds one call per retrieved item; its token cost is reported with the gains. Security framing is limited to manufactured contamination as the brief requires.
Addresses gap: G8 (no read-time detection of harmful retrieved entries, and whether susceptibility depends on writer-reader relation), with G9 (cost of a defence on legitimate non-adversarial foreign content) as the secondary estimand.
Not a restatement of: Brief prior-result bullet Measurement A ('look-at-in-light is the one negative type, -4.8'): it observed one harmful type from one writer without asking whether the reader could have flagged the items; this idea claims the reader's ability to flag a harmful item depends on who wrote it, which the observational result cannot show. Digest card arxiv:2512.16962 (MemoryGraft: benign-looking implanted experiences cause persistent drift, one backbone, no defence): this idea plants identical errors in self- and foreign-written hosts and scores a reader-side detector by precision and recall, claiming the reader's own pool is the harder case. Archived lineage_blast_radius (4.75) was a consolidation-rule result; here no rule exists, the detector is the reader's judgement and its false-positive cost on clean foreign items is measured. Archived closer_beats_stronger (5.75) claimed proximity predicts transfer gain; here proximity is varied at fixed capability (S' host) only to test whether familiarity, not identity, drives a detection failure, a different outcome from transfer gain.
Changes made: P3: the falsifier was conditional on an unmeasured NLL drop and its +-4 band sat inside the noise; now a pre-registered NLL-qualifying rule (self-paraphrase kept only if reader NLL is at or below the 75th percentile of self-host items, best-of-4 then best-of-8, qualifying fraction reported), >= 1300 within-item pairs (half-width about +-3), a CI-based falsifier (upper bound < 4) and a new cross-paraphraser control (the same originals rewritten by the other backbone) so that paraphrase-as-such is separable from familiarity; this makes the mechanism test sharper, not softer. P4: the gap-halving clause had no falsifier; now gap_D1 - 0.5 x gap_D0 with a game-paired bootstrap CI excluding 0 from above falsifies it (the world where D1 lifts both hosts equally), D0 and D1 are scored on identical 1500/1500 item sets so the self-host lift is a within-item paired difference (half-width about +-3) with falsifier CI upper bound < 4, and the gap clause is scored only when P2's gap exists. P5: the leverage ratio was unresolvable because its denominator carried +-5 of its own; replaced by absolute per-retrieval loss on (game, seed, retrieval)-paired episodes pooled over the 30% and 50% cells with 6 seeds for the Qwen3 reader, margin 5 net (twice the +-2.4 half-width, 0.8 of the Gate-0 minimum), falsifier CI upper bound < 5; leverage is now descriptive only. This is a sharper claim than before: the same error costs more per retrieval when self-written, in net points rather than in a ratio. P6: the writer-identity clause was an identity and the <3 vs >=6 cost band sat inside +-5; the identity gate is now a reported comparator (mixed minus self, with CI), the cost clause is (game, seed)-paired at 4 seeds (half-width about +-3) with falsifier CI lower bound > 3, and the false-positive clause uses >= 1500 clean foreign items with falsifier >= 15%. Grid and budget: the 10% rate dropped, separate identity-gate downstream cells dropped (they equal the rate-0 self cells), D-consensus moved to a 600/600 subset, seeds raised only where a paired margin needs them (6 on the Qwen3 rate block, 4 on its mixed cells), the Gate-0 pair run first with an interim rule; arithmetic given per block (about 55k episodes, about 113k verification calls, about 75 replica-hours, about 2 days on two A100s with both replicas kept busy). Added: host S' (same backbone, second scaffold, temperature 1.0) in verification cells only, which varies proximity at fixed capability as the brief requires and gives a familiarity dose-response for P3; host E scored by both readers as a reader-main-effect check; pools collected under one matched rule. Kept unchanged: the core hypothesis, the Name, P1 and the headline P2 at its original 10-point margin, the families, the detectors and the G8/G9 framing.
